children: Qualcomm Technologies and Amazon have agreed to collaborate on developing customized silicon and high-bandwidth optical interconnectivity for Amazon's artificial intelligence data centers.
The collaboration brings together Amazon's comprehensive, secure AI infrastructure with Qualcomm Technologies' processing, silicon design and system-level integration to scale AI inference workloads.

In connection with the deal, Qualcomm will issue a warrant to Amazon to acquire up to 25 million of its shares at $161.26 apiece. The warrant allows for cashless exercise and expires in September 2036.

The warrant shares vest in tranches tied to the execution of certain commercial arrangements, the placement of binding purchase orders and actual purchases of Qualcomm's server chip products, technology, systems and manufacturing services by Amazon during the term of the warrant. That could potentially reach a maximum amount of $60 billion in payments, with 3.75 million shares being vested upon issuance of the warrant based on initial purchase commitments.

Under the agreement, the companies will collaborate on optical connectivity solutions reaching speeds of up to 1.6 terabits per second, using Qualcomm's SerDes and optical digital signal processor technologies.
Qualcomm will expand its use of Amazon Web Services' cloud services and Amazon Bedrock to run electronic design automation workloads aimed at reducing chip design cycles.
The move comes as major tech companies are racing to scale their AI infrastructure, driving a wave of record-setting deals to secure custom silicon, power capacity and next-generation connectivity.
